executive_summary: OFAC added 11 new entities and individuals to the SDN list under the CUBA-EO14404 program, primarily targeting Cuban military and industrial organizations. Two existing entries were also updated to include the CUBA-EO14404 program. No removals were made.

risk_implications.description: Increased sanctions on Cuban military and industrial organizations may lead to heightened tensions and potential retaliation
Additions to the SDN list may impact global trade and commerce, particularly with Cuba and related entities

program_highlights.note: New designations target Cuban military and industrial organizations
Two existing entries were updated to include the CUBA-EO14404 program

compliance_recommendations: Screen for newly added entities and individuals on the SDN list
Review and update internal watchlists and sanctions filters
Conduct enhanced due diligence on transactions involving Cuba or related entities
